states.name: Assam
states.culture: Bihu-centric calendar; strong demand for mekhela sador, gamosa, gold and Durga Puja/Diwali apparel; Fancy Bazaar is the trade hub.
states.ecommerce: Gateway of NE; Flipkart NE growth 35-40% YoY, 6 lakh sq ft warehousing in Guwahati, 1 lakh+ Assam sellers (2025). Amazon: home decor +35%, furniture +50% in festive 2024, 10,000+ sellers.

festivals.name: Bohag Bihu
festivals.significance: Assamese New Year and spring festival; biggest cultural event of Assam
festivals.buys: mekhela sador, gamosa, new clothes, jaapi, pitha ingredients, gifts, dhol/pepa
festivals.impact_reason: Top new-clothes and gifting occasion for Assamese households; drives ethnic wear and gifting online and offline

festivals.name: Magh Bihu
festivals.significance: Harvest feast festival with Uruka night community feasts and Meji bonfires
festivals.buys: pitha ingredients, til, jaggery, chira, jolpan, mekhela sador, gamosa, utensils, fish, meat, winter clothing
festivals.impact_reason: Food-led festival; grocery/quick-commerce spikes, plus winter wear; Guwahati alcohol sales ~Rs 12.5 cr over 2 days

festivals.name: Kati Bihu
festivals.significance: Lean-season Bihu; lamps lit in paddy fields and at tulsi plant
festivals.impact_reason: Austere observance; small puja-goods demand, overlaps Durga Puja season

festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.significance: Largest Hindu festival in Assam with thousands of pandals
festivals.buys: new clothes, sarees, footwear, cosmetics, phones, electronics, jewellery, home decor
festivals.impact_reason: Coincides with Flipkart/Amazon festive sales; Flipkart reports NE growing 35-40% YoY in festive season

festivals.name: Kali Puja and Diwali
festivals.significance: Festival of lights; Kali Puja widely observed by Bengali and Assamese Hindus
festivals.buys: diyas, lights, sweets, gifts, gold, appliances, home decor
festivals.impact_reason: Peak festive-sale window; Amazon saw 30-35% home decor and 50% furniture growth in Assam in festive 2024

festivals.name: Ambubachi Mela
festivals.significance: Annual Kamakhya Temple fair in Guwahati drawing lakhs of pilgrims
festivals.buys: puja items, red cloth, travel, rainwear
festivals.impact_reason: Large pilgrim inflow boosts local hospitality/travel; limited online retail impact

festivals.name: Dol Jatra (Holi)
festivals.significance: Spring colour festival, celebrated at Barpeta Satra with great fervour
festivals.impact_reason: Colours, snacks and festive wear sell online; strong in Barpeta and Guwahati

festivals.name: Me-Dam-Me-Phi
festivals.significance: Tai Ahom ancestor-worship festival
festivals.buys: puja items, traditional food, ethnic attire
festivals.impact_reason: Community ritual; minimal online purchase lift

festivals.name: Bwisagu
festivals.significance: Bodo New Year, coinciding with Bohag Bihu
festivals.impact_reason: Adds Bodoland demand for ethnic textiles and clothes in the Bihu window

festivals.name: Id-ul-Fitr
festivals.significance: End of Ramzan; Assam has ~34% Muslim population
festivals.buys: new clothes, attar, dates, vermicelli, footwear, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Large Muslim population in Lower Assam/Barak drives apparel and grocery demand

festivals.name: Id-ul-Zuha
festivals.significance: Festival of sacrifice
festivals.impact_reason: Mainly offline livestock and food spend

festivals.name: Christmas and New Year
festivals.significance: Celebrated by Christians and widely in Guwahati as a party season
festivals.buys: cakes, decorations, gifts, party wear, winter clothes
festivals.impact_reason: Year-end sales and winter wear demand in urban Assam

festivals.name: Raas Mahotsav
festivals.significance: Vaishnavite Raas performances, famously in Majuli satras around Kartik Purnima
festivals.impact_reason: Tourism and local fairs; little online lift

festivals.name: Vishwakarma Puja
festivals.significance: Worship of tools/machines; popular in tea gardens, workshops, transport
festivals.impact_reason: Small spike in tools/vehicle accessories

festivals.name: Janmotsav of Srimanta Sankardeva
festivals.significance: Birth anniversary of the Vaishnava saint-reformer; Naamghar prayers
festivals.impact_reason: Observance-focused; minor gamosa/puja purchases

festivals.name: Raksha Bandhan
festivals.significance: Sibling festival popular in urban Assam
festivals.impact_reason: Online rakhi and gift delivery common for out-of-state family

festivals.name: Chhath Puja
festivals.significance: Observed by Hindi-speaking Bihari/Marwari communities in Assam
festivals.buys: soop, fruits, puja items, new clothes
festivals.impact_reason: Community-specific; mostly offline

festivals.name: Karam Puja
festivals.significance: Tea-tribe (Adivasi) harvest and nature festival
festivals.impact_reason: Important for tea garden communities; limited online access

festivals.name: Asom Divas
festivals.significance: Commemorates Ahom founder Chaolung Sukapha
festivals.impact_reason: Commemorative; negligible e-commerce lift

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.culture: 26 major tribes each with own fixed-date festival; spend centres on traditional attire, food and community feasts; Christian and Buddhist pockets.
states.ecommerce: Sparse logistics and terrain limit reach; served largely via Assam hubs. Flipkart sources farm produce from Bomdila. NE region growing 35-40% YoY for Flipkart.

festivals.name: Losar
festivals.significance: Monpa/Sherdukpen Tibetan Buddhist New Year in Tawang and West Kameng
festivals.buys: new clothes, home cleaning goods, food, butter lamps, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Main shopping occasion for Tawang/West Kameng; winter and festive apparel

festivals.name: Nyokum
festivals.significance: Nyishi festival for prosperity and harvest; Nyishi is the largest tribe
festivals.buys: tribal handloom attire, traditional jewellery, rice, rice beer
festivals.impact_reason: Largest tribe (Itanagar/Papum Pare); festive attire and food spend

festivals.name: Solung
festivals.significance: Adi agricultural festival; Pasighat and Siang belt
festivals.impact_reason: Main Adi festival; local apparel and food demand

festivals.name: Mopin
festivals.significance: Galo festival for prosperity; white attire and Popir dance in Aalo/Basar
festivals.buys: white traditional attire, rice powder, food
festivals.impact_reason: Galo heartland festive clothing and food spend

festivals.name: Dree
festivals.significance: Apatani crop-protection festival in Ziro valley
festivals.impact_reason: Small Apatani population; mainly local spend

festivals.name: Si-Donyi

festivals.impact_reason: Localized to Upper Subansiri

festivals.name: Reh
festivals.significance: Idu Mishmi prosperity festival in Dibang valley
festivals.impact_reason: Localized; limited online lift

festivals.name: Boori Boot Yullo
festivals.significance: Hill Miri/Nyishi community festival in February
festivals.impact_reason: Localized community event

festivals.name: Sangken

festivals.buys: new clothes, water guns, Buddha puja items, food
festivals.impact_reason: Namsai-focused; small online effect

festivals.name: Bohag Bihu
festivals.significance: State holiday; celebrated in foothill districts bordering Assam
festivals.impact_reason: Assamese and plains population in Namsai/Lohit/Changlang shop for Bihu

festivals.name: Chalo Loku
festivals.significance: Nocte post-harvest festival in Tirap
festivals.impact_reason: Localized

festivals.name: Torgya
festivals.significance: Monastic masked-dance festival at Tawang Monastery
festivals.impact_reason: Tourism-driven; little online retail

festivals.name: Ziro Festival of Music
festivals.significance: Outdoor indie music festival in Ziro valley
festivals.impact_reason: Tourist event; niche outdoor-gear demand

festivals.name: Durga Puja and Dussehra
festivals.significance: Two state holidays; celebrated in Itanagar and plains towns
festivals.impact_reason: Overlaps national festive sales; NE among fastest-growing regions for Flipkart

festivals.name: Diwali
festivals.significance: Festival of lights, state holiday
festivals.buys: lights, sweets, gifts, appliances, home decor
festivals.impact_reason: Festive sale season peak for phones, appliances and decor

festivals.name: Christmas
festivals.significance: Significant Christian population (~30%)

festivals.significance: State holiday honouring Donyi-Polo and indigenous faiths

states.name: Meghalaya
states.culture: Christian-majority; Christmas is the biggest shopping season; fashion-forward youth in Shillong; Khasi matrilineal customs.
states.ecommerce: Unicommerce: Meghalaya top-2 state by order-volume growth in Republic Day 2024 sale. Flipkart sources produce from Garo and Khasi Hills.

festivals.name: Christmas

festivals.name: Good Friday and Easter

festivals.impact_reason: Second Christian occasion for apparel and gifting

festivals.name: Shad Suk Mynsiem

festivals.name: Behdienkhlam

festivals.name: Wangala

festivals.name: Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival

states.name: Sikkim
states.culture: Nepali-majority with Bhutia/Lepcha Buddhists; Dasain-Tihar is peak spend, Losar/Losoong for Buddhists; high per-capita income, tourism economy.
states.ecommerce: Small market (~7 lakh pop.) served via Siliguri hubs; 49 public holidays in 2026 shows dense festival calendar; no state-specific e-com numbers found.

festivals.name: Dasain
festivals.significance: Biggest festival for Nepali-majority Sikkim; tika and family reunions
festivals.buys: daura-suruwal, gunyo-cholo, sarees, new clothes, kids' clothes, puja items, gift hampers, dry fruits, sweets, meat, phones, electronics
festivals.impact_reason: Main annual new-clothes and gifting occasion; coincides with national festive sales

festivals.name: Tihar
festivals.significance: Five-day festival of lights ending in Bhai Tika
festivals.buys: lights, diyas, garlands, sweets, gifts, gold, appliances

festivals.name: Losar
festivals.significance: Tibetan New Year of Bhutia/Sherpa/Tibetan communities
festivals.buys: new clothes, khapse ingredients, home decor, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Bhutia festive apparel and food; winter clothing

festivals.name: Losoong / Namsoong

festivals.buys: traditional wear, gift hampers, home decor, food
festivals.impact_reason: Six-day holiday block in December; winter wear and food
